Multi-band Detection & Jamming Gun

Weight: ≤7kg
Interception Distance: ≥1km (Line-of-sight)
Five-band jamming (900M to 5.8G) covering all mainstream drone frequencies; 1km+ early warning with DJI O2/O3/O4 and National Standard protocol support; ergonomic 7kg lightweight design with swappable batteries; 4 enforcement modes including forced landing and enhanced return.
Get quotationWhatsApp
The multi-band detection and jamming gun provides precise directional suppression, long-range detection warning, and rapid deployment capabilities. It features multiple enforcement modes to effectively neutralize mainstream drones. Equipped with a built-in five-band jamming module covering common UAV communication frequencies, it accurately blocks various signals. The system is compatible with multiple protocols to retrieve drone positioning data while ensuring safe and compliant interception. It balances lightweight portability with extreme environment durability, meeting high-intensity operational and endurance requirements.
  • Overview
  • Technical Specifications
  • Contact us

Key Features

  • Multi-band integrated detection and jamming gun, combining spectrum sensing and directional jamming in one device.
  • Covers all mainstream drone frequency bands: 900MHz/1.5GHz/2.4GHz/5.8GHz.
  • Real-time spectrum analysis for automatic drone signal detection and identification.
  • Directional antenna for precise, targeted jamming with minimal collateral interference.
  • Forces intruding drones to land, return to home, or lose control signal.
  • Effective detection range up to 3km, effective jamming range up to 2km.
  • Built-in high-capacity rechargeable lithium battery.
  • Ergonomic design with integrated display for real-time status monitoring.
  • Ruggedized construction for harsh field environments, IP65 protection.
